newsitem.title: USA: MicroTouch to post charge from dispute.
newsitem.headline: MicroTouch to post charge from dispute.

text.p: MicroTouch Systems Inc said on Wednesday that an arbitration panel has ruled that it could not collect damages from Nissha Printing Co Ltd for breaching a distribution agreement.

The company reiterated that it will incur an additional one-time charge in 1997 since it anticipates that the arbitration panel will require it to reimburse Nissha for at least a portion of the arbitration costs it incurred.
MicroTouch said it does not yet know the amount of costs incurred by Nissha. It also said it does not know the portion of those costs that the panel would award to Nissha.
However, it said those costs could exceed the $2 million in costs incurred by MicroTouch. The amount is expected to be determined by the panel by the end of April, the company said.
The company said that although the panel had ruled that Nissha had breached the agreement, the statute of limitations contained in the pact prevented MicroTouch from collecting damages.
